title: AI vs machine learning vs deep learning

scenes.narration: AI, machine learning, and deep learning are not the same thing.
Welcome to FredsDesk, lesson two. In under a minute, you'll see exactly how they fit together.
Picture three circles, one inside the other. Deep learning sits inside machine learning, and machine learning sits inside AI.
scenes.definition: Deep learning is a type of machine learning, and machine learning is a type of AI.

scenes.narration: Think of cooking. AI is cooking in general, any way a machine can act smart. Machine learning is learning recipes by tasting thousands of dishes. Deep learning is a master chef with a huge brain made of layers.
The difference is who finds the clues. In classic machine learning, people pick the clues for the model. In deep learning, many layers of artificial neurons find the clues by themselves.
ChatGPT is deep learning, which makes it machine learning, which makes it AI. All three labels fit.
scenes.label: Deep learning, inside ML, inside AI
scenes.note: Every ChatGPT is also ML and AI

scenes.narration: Quick recap. One: AI is the big idea. Two: machine learning learns from data. Three: deep learning uses many neural layers.
Quiz time! Is deep learning a type of machine learning? A, yes, or B, no? Answer in the comments. Tomorrow: what is a neural network? Follow FredsDesk, and see you at the desk.
scenes.question: Is deep learning a type of machine learning?
